items.title: Is Dollar General (DG) Undervalued As Traffic Gains Meet Legal Risk?
items.summary: Dollar General has delivered a 31.1% share price gain over the past year, even though the 5 year return is a decline of 34.8%. This puts fresh attention on whether the current US$134.14 price lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate.
